# ADR-3097: A09: Security event logging required key for service 1

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Without security events, detections are blind.

## Decision

Service configuration MUST include a security event logging required key for service 1 (A09-1).

## Consequences

Events cover authn failures and policy denies.
